API Reference › Batch Image Crop

batch_crop.cropGeometry.cropImage

Pad/rotate an image canvas and crop a fixed pixel rectangle.

Syntax

function result = cropImage(imageData, opts)

Description

Expected caller: labkit_BatchImageCrop_app and batch_crop package tests. Inputs are an image array and opts with cropWidth, cropHeight, angleDeg, centerXY in original-image coordinates, paddingPercent, or fillValue. Output preserves image class and returns exactly cropHeight-by-cropWidth pixels, padding when the crop crosses canvas bounds. This helper does not resize the source image and has no file side effects.

Related APIs

  • batch_crop.cropGeometry.cropScaledImage — Crop native physical ROI and resample to target output size.
  • batch_crop.cropGeometry.scalePlan — Choose physical-mode output pixel density and per-image warnings.
